subject: ela
cluster: Range of reading and level of text complexity
intro: Fourth graders read stories, dramas, and poems and understand them deeply, using all their skills: finding the theme, analyzing characters, understanding word meanings, and following the plot. Good readers draw on details from the text to explain their thinking and reread tricky parts.

items.prompt:
Read.

When the flood came, Omar ignored his own fear and rowed his small boat out again and again to carry his neighbors to safety.

What character trait does Omar show?

steps: I look at what Omar does.
He ignores fear and saves his neighbors over and over.

items.prompt:
Read (same passage).

What detail shows Omar is brave?

steps: A detail that shows bravery is facing danger.
He 'ignored his own fear' and went out 'again and again.'
So that detail shows his bravery.
solution.answer: He ignored his fear and rowed out again and again.

items.prompt:
Read.

The miser hid his gold and trusted no one. In the end, he died alone, with no friends to mourn him.

What is the theme?

steps: I think about the lesson the story shows.
His greed and distrust left him alone.
So the theme is that greed and selfishness lead to loneliness.
solution.answer: Greed and selfishness lead to loneliness.

items.prompt:

Even after losing twice, Priya trained harder and entered the contest again.

What trait does Priya show?
